items.evidence: Log shows 48 p1000 cycles, each with its own pick up/drop tip, aspirating 250 uL from a distinct tube into a distinct well (A1-H1, A3-H3 ... A11-H11); elution goes to the matching column of the elution plate.
Log: 40 uL beads, then 125x2 uL IPA per column, then 250 uL sample with 5x400 uL mix; delay 300 s, engage, delay 240 s, then 3x180 uL removed to waste with magnet engaged.
Two rounds of 3x166.667 uL ethanol (reservoir A9-A12) each removed 3x166.667 uL to waste with magnet on, then delay 240 s and disengage before elution.
Elution is added (100 uL) and mixed off-magnet and engaged for 90 s, but the log shows 100 uL aspirated and dispensed to the elution plate (lines 1030-1031) rather than about 80 uL.
The agent adds a 30 s 'Settle beads' delay after each ethanol addition (log lines 804, 891) that is not in the paper, and recovers 100 uL rather than the ~80 uL supernatant.

judge.summary: The protocol correctly handles 48 samples with one tip each. It also follows the binding, separation, wash and drying steps with correct volumes, timings and magnet states. It fails on elution recovery because it collects 100 uL instead of about 80 uL, and on fidelity because it adds an unrequested 30 s settle delay after each ethanol addition.
